body:
New FindMatchMsg payload on PACKET_FIND_MATCH, apps/arena --map-seed N, matchmaker honors it in try_match. Backward compatible (0/no-payload = no preference, unchanged prior behavior). Live-verified end to end: matchmaker log confirms spawned match used exactly the requested seed 424242. Phases 2-4 (2-leg series, slow/fast league, persistent IDUNA map ownership) scoped in NORTHSTAR_MAP_LEAGUE.md, not attempted. ECOWAR 5ee8aed/4272da3/01cba38.
